Bounty Hunter

Bounty Hunter

Bounty Hunters take the contract, find the target, and bring them in, and nothing in the galaxy stays hidden from them for long.

Starting Evasion
10
Starting Hit Points
6
Class Items
A bounty puck for a target you never caught, or a trophy from your first collected bounty

Bounty Hunter's Hope Feature

Wanted Dead or Alive: Spend 3 Hope after you deal damage to your Quarry. Choose one: they mark an additional Hit Point, or the GM tells you one of their vulnerabilities, defenses, or current intentions.

Class Features

Quarry: Spend a Hope to name a creature you can see or are actively hunting as your Quarry. When you accept a paid contract, you can name its target as your Quarry without spending Hope; the client pays a handful of credits when the Quarry is captured or defeated. You can Utilize your Quarry as an Experience (+2) without spending Hope on rolls to track, identify, or pursue them. You can have only one Quarry at a time.

No Escape: When your Quarry attempts to flee, you can spend a Hope to learn where they're heading and move to a point within Close range of them.

Bounty Hunter Subclasses

Choose either the Trapper or Heavy subclass.

TRAPPER

Play the Trapper if you want to bring your targets in alive.

Spellcast Trait: Instinct

Foundation Feature

Capture Specialist: You gain a +2 bonus to rolls to restrain, disable, or capture a creature. When you succeed with Hope on such a roll, the target becomes Vulnerable until it breaks free.

Specialization Feature

Inescapable: Creatures you Restrain have disadvantage on rolls to break free.

Mastery Feature

Bring 'Em In: Once per rest, when you succeed on an attack against your Quarry, they become Restrained. Additionally, when your Quarry would mark their last Hit Point, you can leave them unconscious and Restrained instead.

HEAVY

Play the Heavy if you want to wear the armor and walk through the blaster fire.

Spellcast Trait: Strength

Foundation Feature

Armored Hunter: You ignore the Evasion penalty of armor with the Heavy feature. Once per rest, when you take physical damage, you can reduce its severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

Specialization Feature

Walking Arsenal: You can carry one additional inventory weapon, and you can swap an inventory weapon for an active one without marking a Stress.

Mastery Feature

Beskar Wall: You can use Armored Hunter's severity reduction twice per rest, and you gain a +2 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

Character Guide

Suggested Traits: Agility +1, Strength +0, Finesse +1, Instinct +2, Presence −1, Knowledge +0

Suggested Gear: A280 Blaster Rifle; Blast Vest (Heavy subclass: Clone Trooper Armor)

Clothes: A T-visored helmet, a weathered cape, a jetpack harness, a belt of binders and tracking fobs, a wide-brimmed hat

Personality: A bloodhound, a tax collector, a shark, a lone gunfighter, a clockwork

Background Questions

  • Which bounty did you refuse to collect, and who has never forgiven you for it?

  • What code do you hunt by, and when did you last break it?

  • Who is hunting you right now?

Connections

  • You were once my Quarry. Why didn't I bring you in?

  • What do you do that I swore I'd never do?

  • Why do I split my payouts with you?

No alarms, no screams, no calls for backup.

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to fire a dampener field around the target that encompasses everything within Very Close range of them and follows them as they move.

The target and anything within the area is Silenced until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition, you use Sound Dampener again, or you take Major damage. While Silenced, they can't make noise and can't call for help or reinforcements.

Level 6 Tier 3

Tracking Bug

Level 6 Bounty Hunter Spell · Recall Cost: 0

A comm bug the size of a grain of sand, planted with a handshake.

You can speak to any person you've made physical contact with, through a comm bug you planted on them. Once you've opened a channel with them, they can speak back to you.

Additionally, you can mark a Stress to make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, you can ask the GM one of the following questions and receive an answer:

  • Where are they?

  • What are they doing?

  • What are they afraid of?

  • What do they cherish most in the world?

Counterattack

Level 6 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 0

They swing, they miss, and they pay for it.

When an attack made against you from within Melee range fails, you can mark a Stress and seize the opportunity to deal the weapon damage of one of your active weapons to the attacker.

Level 7 Tier 3

Smoke and Mirrors

Level 7 Bounty Hunter Spell · Recall Cost: 1

A puff of smoke, and you're already behind them.

When an attack made against you that would deal physical damage fails, you can spend a Hope to vanish in a burst of smoke, becoming Hidden and moving to a point within Close range of the attacker. You remain Hidden until the next time you make an action roll.

Hunter's Precision

Level 7 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 1

One clean shot, exactly where it counts.

When you make a successful attack with a weapon, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility.

Level 8 Tier 4

Night Hunter

Level 8 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 2

Your visor turns the dark into daylight.

While you're in low light or darkness, you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and make attack rolls with advantage.

Mark for Death

Level 8 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 3

The first shot tags them. The second one collects.

When you make a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to make the next successful attack against that same target deal an extra 2d12 damage.

Level 9 Tier 4

Collect the Debt

Level 9 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Every step you take closer, the price goes up.

Choose a target within Far range. When you succeed on an action roll against them that doesn't result in making a damage roll, place a token on this card. When you deal damage to this target, spend any number of tokens to add a d12 for each token spent to your damage roll. You can only hold Collect the Debt on one creature at a time.

When you choose a new target or take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Fearsome Reputation

Level 9 Bounty Hunter Spell · Recall Cost: 2

They know your helmet, and they know what it means.

Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to recognize you and what you've done. The targets must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily Horrified. While Horrified, they're Vulnerable.

Steal a number of Fear from the GM equal to the number of targets that are Horrified (up to the number of Fear in the GM's pool). Roll a number of d6s equal to the number of stolen Fear and deal the total damage to each Horrified target. Discard the stolen Fear.

Level 10 Tier 4

Visor Blackout

Level 10 Bounty Hunter Spell · Recall Cost: 2

Smoke and blackout charges fill the room. Your crew's visors see right through it.

Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, plunge the entire area within Far range into complete darkness that only you and your allies can see through. Attack rolls have disadvantage when targeting you or an ally within this darkness.

Additionally, when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary within this darkness, the target must mark a Stress.

This effect lasts until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear it or you take Severe damage.

Rampage

Level 10 Bounty Hunter Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Straight through the cantina, and nobody's left standing.

Spend 3 Hope to run a straight path through the battlefield to a point within Far range, making an attack against all adversaries within your weapon's range along that path. Choose the order in which you deal damage to the targets you succeeded against. For the first, roll your weapon damage with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Then remove a die from your damage roll and deal the remaining damage to the next target. Continue to remove a die for each subsequent target until you have no more damage dice or adversaries.

You can't target the same adversary more than once per attack.

Core Materials›Classes
class portrait

Soldier

Soldier

Soldiers are trained for war and made to fight as one, whether they wear clone armor, a Rebel helmet, or stormtrooper white.

Starting Evasion
10
Starting Hit Points
7
Class Items
Your old unit's insignia, or a set of identity tags that aren't yours

Soldier's Hope Feature

Second Wind: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Stress or a Hit Point.

Class Features

Squad Tactics: When you Help an Ally, you can roll a d8 as your advantage die.

Battlefield Awareness: When the GM makes a move to ambush or surprise you or an ally within Close range, you can spend a Hope to spot it in time. Describe what tipped you off; the ambush fails and the spotlight swings to you.

Soldier Subclasses

Choose either the Commando or Heavy Trooper subclass. Soldier subclasses have no Spellcast trait.

COMMANDO

Play the Commando if you want to strike behind enemy lines and blow up what matters.

Foundation Feature

Special Operations: Gain an additional Experience at +2 that applies only to infiltration, demolitions, or tactical movement.

Specialization Feature

Breach and Clear: When a fight begins with an ambush or infiltration you planned, you and every ally who followed the plan gain advantage on your first attack roll in that fight.

Mastery Feature

Mission Specialist: Your Special Operations Experience increases to +3. Once per rest, when you make a roll that uses it, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

HEAVY TROOPER

Play the Heavy Trooper if you want to pin the enemy down with overwhelming firepower.

Foundation Feature

Suppression: When you succeed on a ranged attack, you can mark a Stress to suppress the target. It temporarily can't move closer to you or your allies.

Specialization Feature

Sustained Fire: When you suppress a target, it also marks a Stress.

Mastery Feature

Walking Fire: Once per rest, spend a Hope to make an attack against every adversary within Very Close range of a point within your weapon's range. Each target you hit is suppressed.

Character Guide

Suggested Traits: Agility +1, Strength +2, Finesse +1, Instinct +0, Presence +0, Knowledge −1

Suggested Gear: A280 Blaster Rifle; Stormtrooper Armor or Clone Trooper Armor

Clothes: Plastoid armor with the markings painted over, olive fatigues, a battered helmet with unit stripes, an ammo bandolier, a stripped deserter's uniform

Personality: A drill sergeant, a sheepdog, a soldier ant, a brick, a veteran

Background Questions

  • Which army did you serve, and why did you leave it?

  • What battle do you still dream about?

  • Who from your old unit is still out there, and would they shoot you on sight?

Connections

  • What order did I disobey to save your life?

  • Why do you keep calling me by my old rank?

  • What did we survive together that we never talk about?

Soldier cards

21 cards, from level 1 to 10. Take two level 1 cards at creation, then one new card each time you level up, at your level or lower.

Level 1 Tier 1

Squad Shield

Level 1 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

A shimmering barrier snaps up, and the blaster bolts splash against it.

Once per rest, mark a Stress to deploy a portable energy shield at a point within Very Close range. Place a number of tokens equal to your Strength on this card (minimum 1). When you or an ally within Very Close range of the shield takes damage from an attack made from beyond Melee range, you can spend a token to reduce the severity by one threshold. The shield collapses when the last token is spent or the scene ends.

Thermal Detonator

Level 1 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

"Grenade out!"

Spend a Hope to make an Agility Roll against all creatures, including allies, within Very Close range of a point you can see within Close range. Targets you succeed against take d8+2 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Battle Command

Level 1 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 0

"Eyes up, squad! Focus fire!"

Once per rest, mark a Stress to bark an order to every ally within Close range who can hear you. Each of them gains a +1 bonus to their next attack roll.

Level 2 Tier 2

Battle Plan

Level 2 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Briefing's over. Everyone knows their job.

After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Knowledge on this card (minimum 1). The first time you move within Close range of an adversary and make an attack against them, you can spend one token to choose one of the following options:

  • You make the attack with advantage.

  • You clear a Stress on an ally within Melee range of the adversary.

  • You add a d8 to your damage roll.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Parade-Ground Voice

Level 2 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 0

When you bark, people listen.

When you make a Presence Roll, you can spend a Hope to add your Strength to the roll.

Additionally, once per rest when you would gain a condition, you can describe how your training carries you through the situation and avoid gaining the condition.

Level 3 Tier 2

Morale Boost

Level 3 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

A perfect shot, and the whole squad cheers.

Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Very Close range can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

Fire Team

Level 3 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

You've drilled this together a hundred times.

When you Help an Ally, they can spend a Hope to add one of your Experiences to their roll alongside your advantage die.

When making a Tag Team Roll, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

Level 4 Tier 2

Cover Me

Level 4 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 2

Suppressing fire buys your squadmate a second chance.

When an ally within Close range fails a roll, you can spend 2 Hope to allow them to reroll either their Hope or Fear Die.

Boost Up

Level 4 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Hands cupped, one heave, and you're over the wall and firing.

Mark a Stress to boost off a willing ally within Close range, fling yourself into the air, and perform an aerial attack against a target within Far range. You have advantage on the attack, add a d10 to the damage roll, and end your move within Melee range of the target.

Level 5 Tier 3

Rallying Strike

Level 5 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

One great hit turns the tide of the whole fight.

Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, you and all allies who can see or hear you can clear a Hit Point or 1d4 Stress.

Tactical Assessment

Level 5 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Count them, size them up, find the weak link.

When observing a creature, you can make an Instinct Roll against them. On a success, spend a Hope and ask the GM for one set of information about the target from the following options:

  • Their unmarked Hit Points and Stress.

  • Their Difficulty and damage thresholds.

  • Their tactics and standard attack damage dice.

  • Their features and Experiences.

Additionally on a success, you can mark a Stress to remove a Fear from the GM's Fear Pool.

Level 6 Tier 3

Adapt and Overcome

Level 6 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Plan A failed. Plan B is already in motion.

When you fail an action roll, your next action roll has advantage.

Field Rest

Level 6 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Grab five minutes of sleep wherever you can.

During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. You can spend a Hope to let an ally do the same.

Level 7 Tier 3

Tough as Durasteel

Level 7 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Patch it, tape it, keep moving.

When you would take damage, you can mark a Stress to reduce the severity of the damage by one threshold. When you do, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, place this card in your vault.

Trained Marksman

Level 7 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Unlike the stormtroopers in the stories, you hit what you aim at.

When you make a successful attack with a weapon, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility.

Level 8 Tier 4

Combat Stims

Level 8 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

One injector, and you feel like you could take on a battalion.

Once per long rest, mark 3 Stress to hit yourself with combat stims and push your body to its limits. Gain a +2 bonus to all of your character traits until your next rest.

Move, Move, Move

Level 8 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

You shove, drag, and shout everyone into position.

Make an Agility Roll against all targets within Close range. Spend a Hope to move targets you succeed against, and any willing allies within Close range, to another point within Close range.

Level 9 Tier 4

Lead the Charge

Level 9 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 3

You hit them first, and the squad follows you in.

When you deal damage to an adversary, you can mark a Stress and describe how you encourage your allies. The next PC to make an attack against that adversary can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

Suppressing Fire

Level 9 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 3

You sweep the whole line with blaster fire.

Spend a Hope and make an attack against all adversaries within your weapon's range. Once per long rest, on a success against any targets, add up the damage dealt, then redistribute that damage however you wish between the targets you succeeded against. When you deal damage to a target, roll an additional damage die and add its result to the damage you deal to that target.

Level 10 Tier 4

Battle-Tested Armor

Level 10 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Every scorch mark on it is a shot that didn't get through.

When you would mark an Armor Slot, roll a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

Veteran's Instincts

Level 10 Soldier Ability · Recall Cost: 2

You've been shot at so often it barely registers.

When an attack made against you fails, clear a Stress. If you can't clear a Stress, gain a Hope.

Core Materials›Classes
class portrait

Technician

Technician

Technicians keep the ships flying, the droids running, and the security systems open, with a hydrospanner in one hand and a datapad in the other.

Starting Evasion
11
Starting Hit Points
5
Class Items
A restraining bolt you refuse to use, or a toolkit inherited from your mentor

Technician's Hope Feature

I Can Fix This: Spend 3 Hope to repair a vehicle or droid within Melee range. Clear a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots on a vehicle or droid PC (Hull or Shield Slots on a starship), or 2 Stress on a droid companion.

Class Features

Tech Specialist: You have advantage on rolls to repair, modify, disable, or understand technology.

Improvise: Once per rest, you can jury-rig a mundane tool, part, or device the situation requires from available materials. It breaks after one use.

Technician Subclasses

Choose either the Mechanic or Slicer subclass.

MECHANIC

Play the Mechanic if you want a loyal droid at your side and every machine in the party running.

Spellcast Trait: Knowledge

Foundation Feature

Droid Companion: You have a droid companion built from a frame of your choice. Take the Droid Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose an upgrade for your droid as well.

Specialization Features

Expert Training: Choose an additional upgrade for your droid.

Field Repairs: When you repair a vehicle or droid during a rest, clear 1 additional Armor Slot, Hit Point, or Stress on it.

Mastery Features

Advanced Training: Choose two additional upgrades for your droid.

Rebuilt Better: When your droid goes Offline, you can spend a Hope during your next short rest to bring it back online with all its Stress cleared.

SLICER

Play the Slicer if you want to break into any system in the galaxy.

Spellcast Trait: Knowledge

Foundation Feature

Systems Intrusion: When you make a roll to slice a computer, security system, or droid, you can mark a Stress after seeing the result to gain a +2 bonus to the roll.

Specialization Feature

Back Door: When you succeed with Hope on a roll to slice a system, you can leave a back door. Once before the end of the session, you can access that system again from anywhere with a comlink signal, without a roll.

Mastery Feature

Total System Control: Once per long rest, make a Spellcast Roll against a droid, turret, or vehicle adversary within Close range. On a success, it acts as you command until the end of the scene or until it takes damage.

Character Guide

Suggested Traits: Agility +0, Strength −1, Finesse +1, Instinct +1, Presence +0, Knowledge +2

Suggested Gear: Ion Blaster Pistol; Shock Baton; Flight Suit

Clothes: Grease-stained coveralls, a heavy tool belt, magnifying goggles, a datapad strapped to the forearm, a jacket covered in patches

Personality: A tinkerer, a raccoon, a puzzle box, an old astromech, a beehive

Background Questions

  • What machine did you build that you're proudest of, and where is it now?

  • What system did you slice into that you should have left alone?

  • Which droid is your oldest friend, and how did you meet?

Connections

  • What did I break that you had to fix?

  • Why do I trust your work with my life?

  • What did you build for me, and why haven't I used it yet?

Technician cards

21 cards, from level 1 to 10. Take two level 1 cards at creation, then one new card each time you level up, at your level or lower.

Level 1 Tier 1

Field Engineer's Kit

Level 1 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 2

Repulsors, plating, and a turret that never sleeps.

Repulsor Blast: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, they're knocked back to Far range and take d10+2 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Energy Plating: Spend a Hope to give a creature or droid you can touch a +1 bonus to their Armor Score until their next rest or you use Energy Plating again.

Sentry Turret: Make a Spellcast Roll (12) to deploy a small automated turret at a point within Close range. Until the end of the scene, instead of attacking with a weapon, you can have the turret fire at a target within Far range of it. Make a Spellcast Roll against the target; on a success, deal d6 physical damage using your Proficiency.

Slicer's Kit

Level 1 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 2

Every system has a back door, if you know where to knock.

Override: Make a Spellcast Roll against a droid or machine within Very Close range. On a success, it shuts down until it takes damage or the GM spends a Fear to reboot it.

Ion Burst: Once per rest, spend any number of Hope to fire an ion charge at a target within Close range. Roll a number of d6s equal to the Hope spent and deal that much physical damage to the target. A droid or vehicle damaged this way must also mark a Stress.

Comm Tap: Spend a Hope to tap into a comlink, comm channel, or computer terminal you can see. Until your next rest or you use Comm Tap again, you can listen in and send messages through it.

Patch Job

Level 1 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

A medpac for the wounded, a hydrospanner for the droid.

When you can take a few minutes to treat a creature with a medpac or repair a droid with your tools, you can spend 2 Hope to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on them.

Once per long rest, when you spend this time learning something new about them or revealing something about yourself, you can clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on them instead.

Level 2 Tier 2

Security Kit

Level 2 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 2

Locks, torches, and sensors: everything you need to get in or keep them out.

Encrypted Lock: Make a Spellcast Roll (15) on an object you're touching that can close (such as a door, hatch, or container). Once per rest on a success, you can lock the object so it can only be opened by creatures of your choice. Someone with slicing tools and an hour of time can break the lock.

Cutting Torch: When you have no adversaries within Melee range, make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend a Hope to cut an opening through a wall, door, or hull within Melee range. It's large enough for one creature at a time.

Sensor Sweep: Make a Spellcast Roll. If there is anything hidden by technology within Close range (such as a hologram, a cloaking field, a hidden compartment, or a listening bug), it is revealed.

Field Medic

Level 2 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Bacta for the soldier, a welding torch for the droid.

Make a Spellcast Roll (13) and target a creature or droid other than yourself within Melee range. On a success, mark a Stress to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on the target. On a failure, mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on the target. You can't treat the same target again until your next long rest.

Level 3 Tier 2

Ordnance Kit

Level 3 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 2

A tether launcher and a shoulder-mounted missile pod.

Ion Tether: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, they're temporarily Restrained and must mark a Stress. If you target a flying creature, this grounds and temporarily Restrains them.

Concussion Missile: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, fire a missile that explodes on impact. The target and all creatures within Very Close range of them must make a Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take d20+5 physical damage using your Proficiency. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Repulsor Kit

Level 3 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 2

Repulsorlifts, a neural scrambler, and a field that bites.

Repulsorlift: Make a Spellcast Roll to temporarily lift a target you can see into the air with a repulsor field and move them within Close range of their original position.

Memory Wipe: Spend a Hope to force a target within Melee range to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, a neural scrambler (or, for a droid, a memory wipe) makes them forget the last minute of your conversation.

Shock Field: Mark a Stress to deploy a temporary shock field on the ground where you stand. All adversaries within Melee range, or who enter Melee range, take 2d12+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Close range.

Level 4 Tier 2

Droidsmith Kit

Level 4 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 3

Give you five minutes and a scrap pile, and you'll build an army of one.

Countermeasure: You can interrupt a technological effect taking place. Make a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. Once per rest on a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided.

Scrap Droid: Spend a Hope to cobble together a droid from the scrap and machinery around you. It obeys basic commands. Make a Spellcast Roll to command it to take action. When necessary, it shares your Evasion and traits and its attacks deal 2d10+3 physical damage. You can only maintain one scrap droid at a time, and it falls apart when it takes any amount of damage.

Auto-Injector

Level 4 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

The injector fires the moment their heart falters.

Spend 3 Hope and choose an ally within Close range. You fit them with an emergency auto-injector. When this ally would make a death move, they clear a Hit Point instead.

This effect ends when it saves the target from a death move, you use Auto-Injector on another target, or you take a long rest.

Level 5 Tier 3

Deployable Barrier

Level 5 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

Two pylons, a flick of a switch, and a wall of energy.

Make a Spellcast Roll (15). Once per rest on a success, spend a Hope to project a temporary energy barrier between two points within Far range. It can be up to 50 feet high and form at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path are shunted to a side of your choice. The barrier stays up until your next rest or you use Deployable Barrier again.

Fabricator

Level 5 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Cut, weld, and reshape anything in reach.

Spend a Hope to reshape a section of metal, plastoid, stone, or other material you're touching using your fabrication tools. The area of the material can be no larger than you. For example, you can form a rudimentary tool or create a door. You can only affect the material within Close range of where you're touching it.

Level 6 Tier 3

Shield Projector

Level 6 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

The dome flickers brighter with every hit it takes.

Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, choose a point within Far range and project a visible shield there for all allies within Very Close range of that point. When you do, place a d6 on this card with the 1 value facing up. When an ally in this zone takes damage, they reduce it by the die's value. You then increase the die's value by one. When the die's value would exceed 6, this effect ends.

Med Station

Level 6 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

A fully stocked field kit, ready for whatever comes in.

After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. Touch a creature or droid and spend any number of tokens to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress for each token spent.

You can also spend a token from this card when touching a creature to clear the Vulnerable condition or treat a physical ailment, such as poison or a disabling malfunction (the GM might require additional tokens depending on the strength of the ailment).

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Level 7 Tier 3

Breaching Kit

Level 7 Technician Grimoire · Recall Cost: 0

No door stays closed for long.

Plasma Cutter: Make a Spellcast Roll (13). Once per rest on a success, you cut a passage and you and all creatures touching you pass through a wall or door within Close range. The opening seals behind you once everyone is through.

Master Override: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, open every locked door, hatch, and security system within Close range. They stay open until your next rest.

Combat Medic

Level 7 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Shoot, then patch, then shoot again.

When you deal damage to an adversary, you can spend 2 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

Level 8 Tier 4

Personal Shield

Level 8 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

A belt-mounted generator wraps them in a shimmering field.

Mark a Stress to activate a personal shield on a target within Very Close range. When the target marks an Armor Slot, they reduce the severity of the attack by an additional threshold. If this card causes a creature who would be damaged to instead mark no Hit Points, the effect ends.

You can only maintain Personal Shield on one creature at a time.

Arc Cannon

Level 8 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

Arcs of raw power leap from the cannon's barrel.

Make a Spellcast Roll to unleash arcs of electricity against all adversaries in front of you within Far range. On a success, spend any number of Hope and force that many targets you succeeded against to make a Reaction Roll (14).

Targets who succeed take 3d20+3 physical damage. Targets who fail take 4d20+5 physical damage and are temporarily Stunned. While Stunned, they can't use reactions and can't take any other actions until they clear this condition.

Level 9 Tier 4

Kill Switch

Level 9 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 3

Every droid has a shutdown code. You've found them all.

Make a Spellcast Roll (18). Once per long rest on a success, the GM tells you which droids, vehicles, and machines within Far range have a Difficulty of 18 or lower. Mark a Stress for each one you wish to affect. They're permanently shut down and can't be reactivated by any means.

Bacta Mist

Level 9 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 2

A spray of bacta sweeps across the line of wounded.

Make a Spellcast Roll (16). On a success, mark any number of Stress to target a line of allies within Far range. You can clear Hit Points on the targets equal to the number of Stress marked, divided among them however you'd like.

Level 10 Tier 4

Overclock

Level 10 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 3

Push every system past its limits, just one more time.

When you or an ally within Close range has used a feature that has an exhaustion limit (such as once per rest or once per session), you can spend any number of Hope and roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the feature can be used again.

Shield Network

Level 10 Technician Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Linked generators spread every hit across the whole team.

Once per long rest, spend 5 Hope to link two or more willing creatures to a shared shield network. Until your next rest, when a creature in the network would mark Stress or Hit Points, the connected creatures can choose who marks it.

Core Materials›Classes
class portrait

Consular

Consular

Consulars win wars without firing a shot. They are senators, envoys, and rebel leaders whose words move worlds.

Starting Evasion
10
Starting Hit Points
6
Class Items
A sealed diplomatic credential, or a holo-recording of a speech that changed your life

Consular's Hope Feature

Rallying Words: Spend 3 Hope to let you and every ally within Close range clear a Stress.

Class Features

Envoy's Poise: You have advantage on Presence Rolls to negotiate, persuade, or de-escalate.

Lead from the Front: When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to give an ally who can hear you a d6. They can add it to the result of their next action roll.

Consular Subclasses

Choose either the Ambassador or Commander subclass.

AMBASSADOR

Play the Ambassador if you want to end conflicts at the negotiating table.

Spellcast Trait: Presence

Foundation Feature

Silver Tongue: Before you make a roll to negotiate, you can ask the GM what the other party wants most. The GM answers honestly.

Specialization Feature

Common Ground: After you learn what the other party wants with Silver Tongue, you have advantage on your next Presence Roll with them.

Mastery Feature

Ceasefire: Once per long rest, spend 3 Hope and make a Presence Roll against the highest Difficulty among the adversaries who can hear you. On a success, they stop fighting until someone attacks them or the scene ends.

COMMANDER

Play the Commander if you want to lead your allies through the chaos of battle.

Spellcast Trait: Presence

Foundation Feature

Follow Me: When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll during combat, choose an ally. They can immediately move to any point within Far range without a roll.

Specialization Feature

Battle Orders: When you use Follow Me, the ally you choose also has advantage on their next attack roll.

Mastery Feature

Inspiring Leader: Once per long rest, give a speech that turns the tide. Every ally within Far range clears 2 Stress and has advantage on their next action roll.

Character Guide

Suggested Traits: Agility +0, Strength −1, Finesse +0, Instinct +1, Presence +2, Knowledge +1

Suggested Gear: Ceremonial Vibrosword; Hold-Out Blaster; Blast Vest, worn under formal robes

Clothes: Senatorial robes, an elaborate headdress, a practical white jumpsuit, a sash of office, a borrowed Rebel uniform

Personality: A chess player, a conductor, a lighthouse, a peacock, a river

Background Questions

  • Which world or people do you speak for, and what do they need most?

  • What treaty or deal did you broker that fell apart, and who paid the price?

  • Who in power owes you a favor, and who wants you silenced?

Connections

  • Why do I listen to you, even when I disagree?

  • What did you once say to me that I've never forgotten?

  • What did I do that nearly ruined one of your negotiations?

Consular cards

21 cards, from level 1 to 10. Take two level 1 cards at creation, then one new card each time you level up, at your level or lower.

Level 1 Tier 1

Spark of Hope

Level 1 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 1

Rebellions are built on words like yours.

After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

  • Your ally clears a Stress.

  • Your ally clears a Hit Point.

  • Your ally gains a Hope.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Read the Room

Level 1 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 0

One glance at the senate chamber, and you know who's really in charge.

When you enter a social scene, you can spend any number of Hope and ask the GM that many questions from the following list:

  • Who holds the real power here?

  • Who is lying or hiding something?

  • What does a person of my choice fear?

  • Who here might help us, and at what price?

Until the end of the scene, gain a +1 bonus to Presence Rolls against anyone you learned about this way.

Command Attention

Level 1 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 0

The room falls silent when you speak.

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Captivated. While Captivated, a target's attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, you can mark a Stress to force the Captivated target to mark a Stress as well.

Level 2 Tier 2

Truth Will Out

Level 2 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Your questions leave no room for lies.

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, your questioning pins them down: they can't lie to you while they remain within Close range, but they are not compelled to speak. If you ask them a question and they refuse to answer, they must mark a Stress and the effect ends. The target typically doesn't realize how cornered they are until the truth slips out.

First Aid

Level 2 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Pressure on the wound, and a calm voice telling them to stay awake.

Make a Spellcast Roll (13) and target a creature other than yourself within Melee range. On a success, mark a Stress to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on the target. On a failure, mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on the target. You can't treat the same target again until your next long rest.

Level 3 Tier 2

Voice of Reason

Level 3 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 1

When you speak, even warlords stop to listen.

You speak with unmatched authority. You have advantage on action rolls to de-escalate violent situations or convince someone to follow your lead.

Additionally, you're emboldened in moments of duress. When all of your Stress slots are marked, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls.

Rally Point

Level 3 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 2

You land a blow, and everyone around you breathes again.

Once per rest, when you succeed on an attack against an adversary, you can clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point. On a success with Hope, you also clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point on an ally within Close range of you.

Level 4 Tier 2

Comforting Presence

Level 4 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 1

A few quiet words while you bandage them up.

During a short rest, when you take the time to comfort another character while using the Tend to Wounds downtime move on them, clear an additional Hit Point on that character. When you do, you also clear 2 Hit Points.

Not on My Watch

Level 4 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 1

"You don't get to quit on me. Not today."

Spend 3 Hope and choose an ally within Close range. Your faith in them becomes something they can hold onto. When this ally would make a death move, they clear a Hit Point instead.

This effect ends when it saves the target from a death move, you use Not on My Watch on another target, or you take a long rest.

Level 5 Tier 3

Sow Dissent

Level 5 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 1

A few words about who's really in charge, and their loyalty cracks.

Whisper words of doubt to an adversary within Melee range and make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, the target must mark a Stress and make an attack against another adversary instead of against you or your allies.

Once this attack is over, the target realizes what happened. The next time you use Sow Dissent on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Spellcast Roll.

Read Their Intentions

Level 5 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 2

Years at the negotiating table taught you to read people.

Spend a Hope to read the surface intentions of a target within Far range from their words and body language. Make a Spellcast Roll against the target to read deeper, more hidden motives.

On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM's discretion, realize you're reading them.

Level 6 Tier 3

Take Their Burden

Level 6 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 0

You carry their fear so they don't have to.

Once per rest, take on the Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. The target confides what's weighing on them. Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.

Restore Morale

Level 6 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 2

You walk through the camp, and everyone stands a little straighter.

After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. Speak with a creature and spend any number of tokens to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress for each token spent.

You can also spend a token from this card when speaking with a creature to clear the Vulnerable condition or ease a lingering mental ailment (the GM might require additional tokens depending on the strength of the ailment).

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

Level 7 Tier 3

Persuasive

Level 7 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 1

You always get a second chance to make your case.

After you make an action roll to persuade, lie, or garner favor, you can spend a Hope to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.

Rally the Wounded

Level 7 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 1

Every blow you strike gives your people the strength to rise.

When you deal damage to an adversary, you can spend 2 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

Level 8 Tier 4

Hold the Floor

Level 8 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 3

The whole chamber hangs on your words.

Make a Spellcast Roll against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against become temporarily Captivated. While Captivated, a target's attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Mark a Stress to force all Captivated targets to mark a Stress, ending this spell.

Holo-Presence

Level 8 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 0

Your flickering blue image addresses a council light-years away.

Once per long rest, mark a Stress to appear as a full-size hologram anywhere you've been before. You can see and hear through the hologram as though it were you, and you can speak and act socially as though you were there, but you can't physically affect anything. Anyone who looks closely can tell it's a hologram. This effect lasts until your next rest or the transmission is disrupted.

Level 9 Tier 4

Seasoned Statesman

Level 9 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 0

Decades of service have sharpened every skill you have.

Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one of your Experiences. Then place this card in your vault permanently.

Diplomat's Insight

Level 9 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 3

You've learned from every ally you've ever served beside.

Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another card of level 8 or lower in another player's loadout. Spend Hope equal to half the card's level to gain access to the feature. It lasts until your next rest or they place the card in their vault.

Level 10 Tier 4

Galactic Renown

Level 10 Consular Ability · Recall Cost: 0

Your name opens doors in every system.

People know who you are and what you've done, and they treat you differently because of it. When you leverage your renown to get what you want, you can mark a Stress before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result. Your food and lodging are always provided wherever you go, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of credits (to a minimum of one handful).

This card doesn't count against your loadout's maximum of 5 cards and can't be placed in your vault.

Second Chance

Level 10 Consular Spell · Recall Cost: 3

"Again. You can do this."

When you or an ally within Close range has used a feature that has an exhaustion limit (such as once per rest or once per session), you can spend any number of Hope and roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the feature can be used again.
